description: Securely log into an OpenShift cluster using username/password or token authentication

certificateAuthority.description: Path to certificate authority file for TLS verification

context.description: Context name to save the login session (optional)

insecureSkipTlsVerify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification (not recommended for production)

namespace.description: Default namespace to set after login

password.description: Password for password authentication (required if authMethod is password)

token.description: OpenShift authentication token (required if authMethod is token)

username.description: Username for password authentication (required if authMethod is password)

name: oc_login
